ambidexterity_1.detail: Passive: Allows a one-handed off-hand weapon in any class. Independent off-hand swings deal 75% damage and grant no ordinary rage.
ambidexterity_1.title: Ambidexterity

anger_management_1.detail: Passive: out-of-combat rage decay becomes 0.5 per turn. Retained across Loops.
anger_management_1.title: Anger Management

art_of_war_1.detail: Passive: Every third landed primary Holy event guarantees your next Judgement crit for 10 turns. At most one event counts per world-turn action, including Seal damage.
art_of_war_1.title: Art of War

bandits_guile_1.detail: Passive: Every 4 landed direct active attacks grant +10% damage, up to 30%, for 12 turns. Misses and finishers do not advance it.
bandits_guile_1.title: Bandit's Guile

battle_shout_1.detail: Increases physical damage by 10% for 30 turns and instantly generates 10 rage. 30-turn cooldown.
battle_shout_1.title: Battle Shout

battle_trance_1.detail: Passive: Direct physical active crits make the next rage-costing active free within 8 turns. Queued strikes cannot trigger it.
battle_trance_1.title: Battle Trance

benediction_1.detail: Passive: Paladin actives cost 20% less rage, rounded up.
benediction_1.title: Benediction

blessing_of_might_1.detail: +10 Strength for 30 turns. Stacks with Battle Shout and Strength of Earth.
blessing_of_might_1.title: Blessing of Might

charge_1.detail: Wind up for one turn, then move at 4 tiles per turn to the nearest empty melee tile. Holds the target in place until melee arrival. Cannot act or cancel during Charge. Generates 10 rage on arrival. 10-turn cooldown.
charge_1.title: Charge

combat_potency_1.detail: Passive: Landed ordinary off-hand swings have a 20% chance to grant 5 rage.
combat_potency_1.title: Combat Potency

conviction_1.detail: Passive: +3% weapon and direct Holy/Nature critical chance.
conviction_1.title: Conviction

divine_purpose_1.detail: Passive: Landed Judgement has a 15% chance to make the next Judgement free within 8 turns.
divine_purpose_1.title: Divine Purpose

divine_shield_1.detail: Immune to all incoming damage for 4 turns; deal 50% less damage. Costs one action; weapon timing continues. Guardian's Favor extends it.
divine_shield_1.title: Divine Shield

earth_shock_1.detail: 120% weapon damage + 8 as Nature damage; hit/crit apply, armor does not. Interrupts and delays the enemy's next swing by 1 turn. One turn; a landed attack builds combo points.
earth_shock_1.title: Earth Shock

elemental_assault_1.detail: Passive: Earth Shock deals 20% more damage. A weapon crit empowers the next Earth Shock by another 50% within 8 turns.
elemental_assault_1.title: Elemental Assault

elemental_weapons_1.detail: Passive: Windfury bonus damage increases 40%; Strength of Earth grants 50% more Strength.
elemental_weapons_1.title: Elemental Weapons

evasion_1.detail: +50% dodge for 5 turns, including attacks from behind. Costs one action.
evasion_1.title: Evasion

eviscerate_1.detail: Requires points. Spend all held combo points for 50% weapon damage plus 8 per point as physical damage. Misses spend points/rage; finisher refunds follow spending. Builds no new attack points. One turn.
eviscerate_1.title: Eviscerate

execute_1.detail: Requires a melee target at or below 20% health and at least 15 rage. Spend up to 30 current rage for 200% weapon damage + 2 damage per rage above 15. Physical hit and crit rules apply; misses spend rage. One turn, no cooldown; weapon timing continues. A landed attack builds Relentless Assault; no combo points are spent.
execute_1.title: Execute

eye_for_an_eye_1.detail: Passive: Surviving an incoming critical hit reflects 30% of damage taken as Holy damage. Reflections cannot proc.
eye_for_an_eye_1.title: Eye for an Eye

feral_spirit_1.detail: Summon 2 wolves on free adjacent tiles for 12 turns, replacing your wolves. Each has 50 health and strikes every 2 turns for 50% of your weapon damage at summoning. They follow your selected enemy, grant no XP/rage/points and can be attacked. Requires 2 free or replaceable tiles.
feral_spirit_1.title: Feral Spirit

guardians_favor_1.detail: Passive: Divine Shield cooldown is 10 turns shorter and its duration is 2 turns longer.
guardians_favor_1.title: Guardian's Favor

heart_of_the_crusader_1.detail: Passive: Landed Judgement gives +3% critical chance against that enemy for 10 turns.
heart_of_the_crusader_1.title: Heart of the Crusader

heroic_strike_1.detail: Reserve 15 rage and wait for the next main-hand swing: 150% weapon damage + 5. No ordinary swing rage; misses consume the strike. Esc or target loss refunds the reservation.
heroic_strike_1.title: Heroic Strike

improved_earth_shock_1.detail: Passive: Earth Shock cooldown is 2 turns shorter; its interrupt also stuns for 2 enemy turns.
improved_earth_shock_1.title: Improved Earth Shock

improved_shields_1.detail: Passive: Lightning Shield has 6 charges and deals 50% more damage.
improved_shields_1.title: Improved Shields

incite_1.detail: Passive: +10% Heroic Strike critical chance. A natural Heroic Strike crit guarantees the next queued strike's crit for 10 turns; that guaranteed crit cannot renew Incite.
incite_1.title: Incite

instant_poison_1.detail: Coat your current main/off-hand weapons for 30 turns. Each landed primary weapon attack has 30% chance to add 8 Nature damage. Bonus strikes cannot trigger poison.
instant_poison_1.title: Instant Poison

judgement_1.detail: Requires Seal of Command. Deal 150% weapon damage as Holy damage; hit chance and crit apply, armor does not. One turn; seal remains active.
judgement_1.title: Judgement

juggernaut_1.detail: Passive: Charge cooldown is 2 turns shorter; arrival guarantees the next Mortal Strike crit within 6 turns.
juggernaut_1.title: Juggernaut

lightning_shield_1.detail: Three Nature-damage charges for 30 turns. At most one discharge per 3 turns. Refreshing counts as a use.
lightning_shield_1.title: Lightning Shield

main_gauche_1.detail: Passive: Landed main-hand swings have a 15% chance for an off-hand bonus strike. Requires an off-hand weapon; no recursive procs or rage.
main_gauche_1.title: Main Gauche

mortal_strike_1.detail: 200% weapon damage. One turn; weapon timing continues. 4-turn cooldown.
mortal_strike_1.title: Mortal Strike

opportunity_1.detail: Passive: Direct physical actives deal 20% more damage from behind.
opportunity_1.title: Opportunity

precision_1.detail: Passive: +5% weapon and direct Holy/Nature hit chance.
precision_1.title: Precision

pursuit_of_justice_1.detail: Passive: +20% movement credit: periodically move an extra tile in the chosen direction, stopping at obstacles.
pursuit_of_justice_1.title: Pursuit of Justice

relentless_assault_1.detail: Passive: landed direct active attacks grant 1 player-held combo point, up to 5, across classes and targets. Auto-attacks, procs, buffs and misses grant none. Points reset on death.
relentless_assault_1.title: Relentless Assault

relentless_strikes_1.detail: Passive: Finishers have a 20% chance per point spent to refund 15 rage, after spending.
relentless_strikes_1.title: Relentless Strikes

restless_blades_1.detail: Passive: Finishers reduce remaining offensive and defensive ability cooldowns by 1 turn per point spent.
restless_blades_1.title: Restless Blades

ruthlessness_1.detail: Passive: After a finisher spends points, 60% chance to refund 1 combo point.
ruthlessness_1.title: Ruthlessness

sacred_duty_1.detail: Passive: Landed Judgement has a 25% chance to guarantee the next Judgement crit within 8 turns.
sacred_duty_1.title: Sacred Duty

sanctity_of_battle_1.detail: Passive: Judgement cooldown is divided by current attack haste, rounded up to at least 1 turn.
sanctity_of_battle_1.title: Sanctity of Battle

seal_fate_1.detail: Passive: Direct active crits grant one additional combo point after Relentless Assault. Finishers and bonus strikes do not qualify.
seal_fate_1.title: Seal Fate

seal_of_command_1.detail: Landed main-hand swings add 50% weapon damage as Holy damage for 30 turns. Bonus damage grants no rage, class XP or combo points. Judgement leaves the seal active.
seal_of_command_1.title: Seal of Command

shaman_flurry_1.detail: Passive: Weapon crits grant 3 charges of +30% attack haste for 10 turns, replacing rather than stacking with Warrior Flurry.
shaman_flurry_1.title: Flurry

slice_and_dice_1.detail: Requires at least 1 combo point. Spend all held points for +30% attack speed, lasting 5 turns plus 3 per point. Ordinary ability cooldowns are unchanged.
slice_and_dice_1.title: Slice and Dice

spirit_hunt_1.detail: Passive: Spirit wolves heal you for 50% of their actual damage dealt.
spirit_hunt_1.title: Spirit Hunt

static_shock_1.detail: Passive: Landed primary weapon attacks have a 20% chance to discharge a Lightning Shield charge, ignoring its retaliation cooldown.
static_shock_1.title: Static Shock

strength_of_earth_totem_1.detail: Place a 5-health totem for 30 turns: +10 Strength within 4 tiles. Replaces your previous earth totem.
strength_of_earth_totem_1.title: Strength of Earth Totem

sudden_death_1.detail: Passive: Landed primary weapon attacks have a 10% chance to allow one free Execute at any health within 8 turns. The proc Execute spends no extra rage.
sudden_death_1.title: Sudden Death

sweeping_strikes_1.detail: Passive: Landed direct physical actives copy 50% of their damage to one other hostile enemy in melee. Copies cannot proc, crit or generate rage/combo points.
sweeping_strikes_1.title: Sweeping Strikes

vengeance_1.detail: Passive: Primary attack crits grant +5% damage, stacking 3 times for 10 turns.
vengeance_1.title: Vengeance

victory_rush_1.detail: Passive: Enemy kills heal 10% of maximum health. Summons and friendly actors do not qualify.
victory_rush_1.title: Victory Rush

warrior_flurry_1.detail: Passive: Weapon crits grant 3 charges of +20% attack haste for 10 turns. Ordinary main/off-hand swings consume charges. Shaman Flurry upgrades this same effect.
warrior_flurry_1.title: Flurry

whirlwind_1.detail: One weapon attack against each adjacent enemy in stable actor order. Each landed hit can crit/proc and build combo points. Stops on terminal death; one class XP use.
whirlwind_1.title: Whirlwind

windfury_weapon_1.detail: Enchant the current main-hand weapon for 30 turns. Landed primary main-hand swings/physical actives have 20% chance for 2 weapon bonus strikes, at most once per 3 turns. Bonuses do not proc or grant rage/combo points.
windfury_weapon_1.title: Windfury Weapon

wrecking_crew_1.detail: Passive: Weapon crits grant +10% physical damage for 6 turns.
wrecking_crew_1.title: Wrecking Crew
